name: Phasing — the card itself, what it is attached to, or a group phases out as the ability resolves (Mist Dragon, Vanishing, Vaporous Djinn, Teferi's Protection, Galadriel's Dismissal, Divine Smite)
notes: 2026-11-20. Only "target … phases out" was done; "This creature phases out", "Enchanted creature phases out" and "All permanents you control phase out" did nothing and were done by hand. Now each is a marker (_phaseWho source / attached / group) and _applyFiredPhase works out who it is as the ability resolves and keeps that list (pseudo._phaseGroup). Mist Dragon's fired ability phases out Mist Dragon. Vanishing's phases out the creature it enchants (Hill Giant), and Vanishing with it. Vaporous Djinn's upkeep trigger asks whether {U}{U} was paid: paid, it stays. Teferi's Protection, cast by Player 3, phases out Player 3's Plains and nothing of anyone else's (the Forest stays: Kird Ape is 2/3), and its list is fixed as it resolves: Player 3's Grizzly Bears, added after, are not in it. Galadriel's Dismissal kicked phases out each creature the picked player (Player 3: the Bears) controls instead of its target, so Craw Wurm stays. Divine Smite does not phase out a black target (it is exiled instead, by hand): Black Knight stays. Giant Growth lists exactly the creatures still in: Kird Ape, Vaporous Djinn, Craw Wurm, Black Knight.

scryfallData.name: Black Knight
scryfallData.oracle_text:
First strike (This creature deals combat damage before creatures without first strike.)
Protection from white (This creature can't be blocked, targeted, dealt damage, or enchanted by anything white.)
scryfallData.flavor_text: Battle doesn't need a purpose; the battle is its own purpose. You don't ask why a plague spreads or a field burns. Don't ask why I fight.
